{
  "analysis": "Git and openssh-server are now installed. I need to create the `user` account, initialize a bare git repo at `/git/server`, set up a web root, create a `post-receive` hook to deploy pushed content to the web root, start sshd, and start an HTTP server on port 8080.",
  "plan": "Run the full setup: create the `user` account, initialize a bare repo with `master` as default branch, create the web root at `/var/www/server`, write a `post-receive` hook that checks out pushed files into the web root, set ownership so `user` can push and the hook can write, then start sshd and a Python HTTP server on port 8080. After that, verify services and test the pipeline end-to-end.",
  "commands": [
    {
      "keystrokes": "useradd -m -s /bin/bash user
git init --bare --initial-branch=master /git/server
mkdir -p /var/www/server
cat > /git/server/hooks/post-receive << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
export GIT_DIR=/git/server
export GIT_WORK_TREE=/var/www/server
git checkout -f
EOF
chmod +x /git/server/hooks/post-receive
chown -R user:user /git /var/www/server
mkdir -p /run/sshd
/usr/sbin/sshd
nohup python3 -m http.server 8080 --directory /var/www/server > /var/log/http8080.log 2>&1 &
",
      "duration": 1.0
    },
    {
      "keystrokes": "ss -ltnp | grep -E ':22|:8080'
ls -la /git/server/hooks/post-receive
cat /git/server/hooks/post-receive
ls -la /git/server
ls -la /var/www/server
",
      "duration": 0.1
    },
    {
      "keystrokes": "su - user -c 'git config --global init.defaultBranch master && git config --global user.email "test@example.com" && git config --global user.name "Test User" && cd /tmp && rm -rf test-repo && git clone /git/server test-repo && cd test-repo && echo "hello world" > hello.html && git add hello.html && git commit -m "add hello.html" && git push origin master'
curl http://localhost:8080/hello.html
",
      "duration": 2.0
    }
  ]
}
